description.text: 1. Specialized required courses History Of Chinese Political Thoughts History Of Chinese Political System Foreign Government And Politics Of Political Science Comparative Political Science Analysis Of Rural Politics In China Foreign Secective Readings In Political Science Public Administration Theory 2.Period of Study After formal admission, students will have a full-time study for 4 years in China University of Political Science and Law (CUPL). 3. Tuition and Application Fee of the Preparatory Courses Tuition is 20,000 RMB per year; application fee is 660 RMB. Those whose Chinese proficiency is under HSK level 5,without receiving preparatory courses and intend to directly enter bachelor's degree studyneed to pay the application service fee 10,000 RMB (including the related costs used for: Chinese courses, major courses, guidance to studying abroad, selection of majors and completion of relevant procedures etc.). 4. Scholarship Foreign students will obtain "the scholarship for freshmen", once they are admitted by our university as freshmen. 5. Accommodations Students can live in the students’ apartments arranged by the School of International Education, or solve accommodations by themselves.

duration.text: The Politics and Public administration Science at China University of Political Science and Law is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2777 USD/per year ￥ 20000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. Graduation certificate of high school Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4. Academic transcript of high school 5. HSK Certificate (No need for English-taught program) Level 5 or above 6.A copy of the visa page with the date of entry into China The students without a visa need not submit.

requirements.text: 1.Applicant must be a non-Chinese citizen 2.Applicants must be in good health 3.Applicant must have the equivalent education of the high school graduates of the People’s Republic of China, generally above the age of 18. (If he’s less than 18 years old, the student needs to submit the notarial certificate by his guardian in Beijing, otherwise will not be accepted.) 4.Applicant should have certain Chinese communication skills. 5.HSK level 5 or above
